his: The solar plexus is the most vulnerable part of the torso. One punch there hurts a lot, as I sadly learned while getting beaten up every day at kindergarten recess by a gang organized by my best friend. Can you believe it?

his: When somebody tells me they want to kill themselves, I get stricter about spirituality, not looser.

label: If You Want to Kill Yourself P7 alone, with his father's line back (his published words)
his: My father used to tell suicidal people, "Oh, you want to kill yourself? That's wonderful. Now you can change what you've always been too afraid to change in your life, and then see if you still want to end it!" His point wasn't that dying is wonderful.
